annotations.title: Take a picture of an app

description: Opens one page of a deployed app in a browser and returns a picture of it, with any errors the page reported while it loaded. Use it after a deploy to see what a person will see, which rows and logs cannot show: a blank page, a broken layout, text that does not fit. A preview deployed without an account is shown as a guest. An app in the account is shown signed in as the connected person. Only for apps the person owns or administers.

app.description: The app's slug: the first label of its address (my-app for https://my-app.fuast.com). list_apps shows the slugs you can use.

dark.description: The visitor's dark setting. Default light.

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

full_page.description: The whole page, not only the first screen.

height.description: Window height in pixels, to override the default.

mobile.description: A phone (390 by 844) instead of a desktop window (1280 by 800).

path.description: The page, as a path from the app's root, like /orders or /orders/12?tab=open. Default /.

width.description: Window width in pixels, to override the default.

name: screenshot_app
title: Take a picture of an app
